description: Shared test vectors for the automation lease (plans/cmux-next/automation-lease.md). The browser host (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-browser-host) and the CUA host (manaflow-ai/cmux-cua, cmux-cua-core lease, vendored copy) both replay every case from an empty host and must produce the same result, lease snapshot and lease frames after each step. Change the contract, this file and both implementations together.
